card.name: Labor union and collective bargaining talk
card.fires_on: Words in labor-relations text where the word "union" is likely to come next, such as "for" or "collective" in collective bargaining rights for public-sector workers. Also "of" after a union leader title or "Federation".

modes.label: Bargaining rights phrases
modes.description: Linking words inside talk of collective bargaining rights for public or state workers.
modes.example: Ohio have pushed laws seeking to curb collective bargaining rights<< for>> state workers.

modes.label: Union organization names
modes.description: "of" after a union role or federation name, where a union name follows.
modes.example: former president<< of>> the Service Employees International Union.

modes.label: Union membership statistics
modes.description: A space just before a percentage of public-sector union membership.
